Recently, Roberto was building his new home, went to the store to grab supplies and came back to his home being all in flames.  Roberto put his entire life savings into the home, losing his belongings, including his car in the process. DK.title: Steak with Creamy Spicy Mushroom Sauce & Parmesan Hasselback Baby Potatoes Ingredients Steak 2 steaks sirloin or fillet, around 200–250g each 1 tbsp neutral oil 1 tbsp butter 2 garlic cloves, lightly crushed 2 sprigs thyme and rosemary Salt Freshly cracked black pepper Season generously with salt and black pepper. Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat and add the oil. Once very hot, add the steaks. For steaks around 2–2.5 cm thick: Rare: approximately 2 minutes per side Medium-rare: approximately 2½–3 minutes per side Medium: approximately 3–4 minutes per side During the final minute, add the butter, crushed garlic and thyme. Tilt the pan and repeatedly spoon the foaming butter over the steaks. Remove the steaks and rest for 5–10 minutes. Keep all the juices from the resting steak,they go into the mushroom sauce. Creamy Spicy Mushroom Sauce 200 g mushrooms, sliced 1 small shallot, finely diced 1 tbsp butter 1–2 tsp dijon mustard (i used yellow, its what i had) 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp chilli flakes, or to taste 1 tsp garlic powder ½–1 tsp dried or fresh thyme Salt, to taste Freshly cracked black pepper 100 ml beef stock The juices released from the rested steak 150 ml double cream 1–2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped  Parmesan Hasselback Baby Potatoes 500 g baby potatoes 2 tbsp olive oil 30 g butter, melted 2 garlic cloves, minced  30–40 g grated Parmesan 1 tsp rosemary or thyme Salt Black pepper 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped Method: Make thin Hasselback cuts in the baby potatoes, coat with the oil, butter, garlic and seasoning, then air fry at 190°C for 20–25 minutes, checking and brushing halfway through. Once tender and crispy, toss in butter, garlic , Parmesan and parsley.

GLOBAL.title: “I lost everything when my home burned down” 🥹❤️ (CROWDFUND L1NK 1N B10) @Kygo #kindness #chef #lasvegas #family #surprise  Internet meet Roberto. Roberto is a 63 year old husband and father, currently working as a chef in Las Vegas. Recently, Roberto was building his new home, went to the store to grab supplies and came back to his home being all in flames.  Roberto put his entire life savings into the home, losing his belongings, including his car in the process. To make matters worse, the insurance company is not covering the cost of the damages and lost items. Roberto works as a chef and his wife works as a porter at the nearby Red Rock Casino, but as a hard working couple in hopes of retiring one day, this tragic experience and news is detrimental to their future.  Let's all come together and show Roberto the power of the internet and bless him and his family. 100% of the net funds raised will go to covering Roberto’s living expenses and finding him a home. Be kind and love always ❤️

GLOBAL.title: Steak with Creamy Spicy Mushroom Sauce & Parmesan Hasselback Baby Potatoes Ingredients Steak 2 steaks sirloin or fillet, around 200–250g each 1 tbsp neutral oil 1 tbsp butter 2 garlic cloves, lightly crushed 2 sprigs thyme and rosemary Salt Freshly cracked black pepper Season generously with salt and black pepper. Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat and add the oil. Once very hot, add the steaks. For steaks around 2–2.5 cm thick: Rare: approximately 2 minutes per side Medium-rare: approximately 2½–3 minutes per side Medium: approximately 3–4 minutes per side During the final minute, add the butter, crushed garlic and thyme. Tilt the pan and repeatedly spoon the foaming butter over the steaks. Remove the steaks and rest for 5–10 minutes. Keep all the juices from the resting steak,they go into the mushroom sauce. Creamy Spicy Mushroom Sauce 200 g mushrooms, sliced 1 small shallot, finely diced 1 tbsp butter 1–2 tsp dijon mustard (i used yellow, its what i had) 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp chilli flakes, or to taste 1 tsp garlic powder ½–1 tsp dried or fresh thyme Salt, to taste Freshly cracked black pepper 100 ml beef stock The juices released from the rested steak 150 ml double cream 1–2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped  Parmesan Hasselback Baby Potatoes 500 g baby potatoes 2 tbsp olive oil 30 g butter, melted 2 garlic cloves, minced  30–40 g grated Parmesan 1 tsp rosemary or thyme Salt Black pepper 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped Method: Make thin Hasselback cuts in the baby potatoes, coat with the oil, butter, garlic and seasoning, then air fry at 190°C for 20–25 minutes, checking and brushing halfway through. Once tender and crispy, toss in butter, garlic , Parmesan and parsley.
